requirements: Each document is a regular non-symlink file beneath the exact Integration checkout root.
Each document path and SHA-256 is supplied by a committed Integration route and verified before child start.
Schedule, grant, and session are parsed and cross-bind task, direction, process, slot, claim hash, worker branch, exact worker HEAD, output root, maximum child starts, and each other's hashes.
The future source-production profile is a PLAY-027 North authority with a committed path and SHA-256; direction cells may not substitute a lane-local synthetic North profile.
The Blender executable path, SHA-256, Mach-O architecture, version, build hash, factory-startup, disabled-autoexec, and python-exit-code flags equal the accepted North binding.
The child requires launcher-only environment hashes plus the exclusive output-root inode and rejects direct invocation.
The output root is an absent direction-owned leaf created exclusively before Blender starts; every output is a fixed leaf beneath that root and overwrite is forbidden.
A failed or partial output root is preserved and cannot be reused; no second child starts under the same session.

portal: One reachable compound portal assembly is derived from the freight aperture bounds, not independently from three jamb/header AABBs.
The assembly contains visible frame solids, side/header reveal surfaces, and a recessed dark back plane.
No Empty object, name token, disconnected mini-frame, or solid uncut hall face can satisfy the portal obligation.
pipeElbow: Every elbow is a bounded quarter arc or equivalent non-collinear curve with explicit endpoints and end caps.
A full torus, straight segment, collinear control points, or unused helper fails validation.
truss: At least one manifest component reaches the truss builder.
Chords and diagonals bind explicit distinct endpoints and are rotated/aligned along those endpoints.
Direct helper invocation, token presence, or axis-aligned proxy boxes do not establish reachability.
mullions: At least one reachable facade component produces separated frame bars and glazing or louver slats with visible gaps.
A single solid cuboid cannot satisfy the mullion obligation.
renderableTopology.fallback: Unknown renderable geometry kinds fail closed; no generic AABB fallback is allowed.

requiredAdversaries: wrong Integration checkout root or symlinked authority document
wrong PLAY task, direction, process, slot, claim hash, branch, worker HEAD, output root, child-start limit, document hash, or cross-document hash
missing, empty, lane-local, wrong-task, or wrong-hash North source-production profile
direct child invocation or caller-controlled output escape
wrong Blender binary path, SHA-256, architecture, version, build, or safety flags
portal Empty, split mini-frames, missing reveal/back plane, or solid face across aperture
full-torus, collinear, uncapped, unreachable, or unused elbow
absent/unreachable truss component or unaligned chord/diagonal endpoints
solid mullion proxy or absent visible gaps
